highlights.title: An Experimental Project That Built Real Trust
points: Ajmal Perfumes — influencer coverage for their new store opening
Ahli United Bank — 500+ customized VIP Eid gift boxes
Marketing strategy for ALNAJJAR Tower, Premax, Credimax, UTB, The Collective Hub, Kyro, and Wyndham Grand Hotel
Ongoing work with Bahrain Duty Free, EazyPay, and Ferrari Bahrain
highlights.story:
Doponda was an experiment — launching a creative services brand from scratch always is. It had its share of wins and hard lessons, and both shaped the way I approach client work today. But in under two years, that experiment turned into a genuinely trusted client base spanning banking, luxury retail, hospitality, and automotive.

One project that stands out is the VIP Eid gift box collection produced for Ahli United Bank — over 500 fully custom, premium-branded boxes delivered for their top clients, right down to the engraved detailing and curated contents. It's a good example of what the Doponda chapter was really about: taking an idea from concept to a polished, client-ready result, even while still figuring the business itself out along the way.

highlights.title: ALNAJJAR Tower — Marketing Strategy for Rivan Properties
points: Full marketing strategy proposal for a landmark residential tower
TikTok engagement plan built around storytelling, influencer partnerships, and branded challenges
Defined KPIs: follower growth, reach, video views, and inquiry conversion
highlights.story:
For Rivan Properties' ALNAJJAR Tower, Doponda built out a full go-to-market strategy — including a dedicated social engagement plan designed to give a real estate landmark a genuine digital presence rather than just listing photos.

The TikTok strategy leaned into storytelling, trend integration, influencer partnerships, and branded challenges, paired with clear KPIs around engagement, reach, and lead generation — treating the tower's launch like a real content platform, not just an ad campaign.

highlights.title: Growing With MEVS Egypt
points: Started in 2019 as a part-time exhibitor on the show floor
Returned years later as Marketing Manager & Project Manager
Led marketing strategy, sponsor campaigns, and on-ground production
highlights.story:
My connection with MEVS (Middle East Vape Show) Egypt goes back further than my title suggests. It began in 2019, as a part-time exhibitor on the show floor — a first hands-on look into the industry's B2B and events side.

That early experience laid the groundwork. Over the following years, I built on it — eventually returning to MEVS Egypt in a very different capacity: as Marketing Manager and Project Manager, leading the show's marketing strategy, sponsor campaigns, and on-ground production from the front.

The role brought together everything from B2B sponsor activation to full-scale creative production — including directing a campaign video built specifically for exhibitor sponsors, produced end-to-end from concept through final cut.

BTS: Producing the B2B Exhibitor Sponsor Campaign Video
The Final Result: Sponsor Campaign Video

highlights.title: VIP Sponsor Lounge — From Render to Reality
points: Designed for Chubby Gorilla's VIP sponsor lounge at MEVS Egypt
Full concept-to-execution: 3D render through on-ground build
highlights.story:
One of the standout deliverables from the MEVS Egypt work was designing the VIP sponsor lounge for Chubby Gorilla — from concept through 3D render to full on-ground execution.

The design brought the sponsor's branding to life across the space: custom signage, a branded VIP zone, and an immersive lounge experience for the show's top guests and exhibitors. What started as a 3D concept render came together on-site exactly as envisioned.
